title: Threads Mod deterministic split-source, descriptor-bound Smali proof, passive-blocking, signed-update and signed-review patchlet catalog
description: Replays the reviewed clone identity, allowlisted GitHub raw/jsDelivr/AWS signed block-list mirrors with freshest-verified selection, strict whole-payload verification, atomic SQLite v2 ID and username indexes with exact total/new-record metadata and fail-closed v1 migration, ten-minute foreground refresh guards, tri-state indexed visible-row passive admission, one immutable target per scheduler owner with manual-first drains, callback-free exact-SHA already-blocked preflight, repeated authority checks before durable running state, passive attempt-plus-delay reservation, no configurable admission caps, manual inline attempts unpaced, checked scheduler wakes, backoff/watchdog/completion quarantine, and bounded identifier-free diagnostics. It also owns shell-first private Activity and Settings pages with live fetch/index/button status, the native left-drawer entry, one post-Share Block control that does not wait on viewer initialization, one compact Block and report modal, code-first canonical Threads post URLs with strict permalink fallback and a bounded no-text excerpt, AWS-only durable report delivery, app-scoped SOCKS5 VPN transport, and Ed25519-signed in-app updates. The exact-primary-DEX Activity probe parses bounded DTD-free UI XML, requires viewport-intersecting nonzero node bounds, distinguishes exact fixed labels from one contiguous ordered multiline sequence of five nonempty dynamic status values, and executes one positive plus nine bypass-negative matcher fixtures. Release gates remain exact-source-SHA-bound, idempotent, primary-DEX-budgeted, archive/alignment/signature checked, and raw signed-DEX reviewed.
